integrity: Exact symbolic proof with reproducible rational example and original-map finite-difference checks. Prior art comparison documents isotropic masked discrete cycles and continuous-time negative-definite spectral selection. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Local two-token antipodal-eigencycle classification only; no global basins or uniqueness among all periodic orbits. Boundaries are nonhyperbolic and nonlinear behavior there is unresolved.
title: Anisotropy-selective antipodal two-cycles in two-token self-attention
